audit.auditor: Principal Website Audit — Arena Agent Mode
audit.scope: Technical SEO, Content/E-E-A-T, Schema, AEO, GEO, Performance, Backend/Code, Security, Accessibility/UX, Editor/CMS, Analytics/Monitoring
assumptions: Deploy target: Oracle Cloud VPS (Docker) behind Cloudflare proxy — confirmed by owner
Access available: server logs / admin panel — owner confirmed; Cloudflare dashboard screenshots pending
No staging environment known → production tests were passive/non-destructive only

Direct curl/Lighthouse from audit sandbox blocked by egress policy; live checks performed via fetch_page (HTTP status + rendered content) and DoH for DNS. Header-level and CWV lab/field verification pending (tool limitation).
notVerified: Core Web Vitals lab+field (PSI API returned 429 quota exceeded) — need PSI/GSC screenshots
Response headers (CSP/HSTS/Cache-Control) live dump — need DevTools or server log access
TLS configuration (testssl/SSL Labs unreachable from sandbox)
Search Console coverage/CWV/manual actions — no GSC access provided
AI-answer engine citations (ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews) — interactive test required
Cloudflare cache/WAF/bot rules — dashboard screenshots pending
Server-side error logs for /api/og 500 root cause — grep for '[og]' or 'Failed to generate image'
SPF/DKIM/DMARC effectiveness at receivers (record existence verified via DNS-over-HTTPS)
tools: fetch_page (live HTML rendering + status codes; robots/sitemaps/RSS/404/OG route)
dns.google DoH JSON API (SPF/DMARC/DKIM TXT records)
web_search (current Google/OWASP/AI-crawler guidance, brand mentions, site: sampling)
npx tsc --noEmit; npm run lint; npm test (vitest)
Static code review of full repository (Next.js 16 App Router, middleware, actions, editor, Docker/CI)

scores.justification: Self-referencing canonicals, News sitemap, SSR, noindex hygiene sab theek; lekin main sitemap (pages.xml) ke dynamic URLs live missing, /api/og 500, aur crawlable pagination na hone se indexing pipeline majorly受损. Ads.txt 404 bhi is bucket me.
Trust pages complete, team bios, review workflow, original data-rich articles (information gain strong); lekin corpus sirf 5 articles, brand messaging 3 tarah inconsistent, author-page polish gaps.

WebSite+Organization+NewsArticle/TechArticle+Breadcrumb+Person+FAQ/HowTo graph — better than most sites; entity @id linkage aur category breadcrumbs missing; rich-result deprecations honest rehne chahiye.
Answer-first paragraphs, question headings, tables, FAQ/takeaway/TOC blocks present; lekin question-hub/PAA-target pages aur comparison hubs abhi nahi — corpus ki wajah se coverage limited.

SSR clean HTML + AI bots allowed (retrieval ke liye sahi); lekin external entity presence (Wikipedia/Wikidata/directories) zero, llms.txt absent, AI-citation testing pending — citation-worthiness abhi proven nahi.

Field/lab metrics verify nahi ho sake (PSI 429) — score code-level review se: LCP hero priority+sizes ✓, fonts self-hosted swap ✓, ads min-height CLS-safe ✓, code-splitting mostly ✓; lekin StoryRow fill images bina sizes (100vw), react-tweet statically bundled, aur ISR-miss TTFB path par R2 fetch.

Auth/rate-limit/uploads/CSP-nonce/HSTS strong aur prod deps 0 vulns; lekin public repo me live API key exposed (Critical), CSP static pages par 'unsafe-inline', DMARC p=none — yeh teeno score neeche khinchte hain.
tsc PASS, 557/557 tests PASS, capability-based RBAC, health checks; lekin lint 351 errors se fail, CI me lint/build gate nahi, deploy me rollback/health-gate nahi.
Skip-link, form labels, aria-live, focus-visible, motion-reduce code me verified; axe-core/headless run sandbox me possible nahi — manual/PSI a11y run pending isliye partial.

TipTap block editor, autosave, revisions+restore, schedule, review workflow, media pipeline strong; lekin SEO panel ke primary fields (metaTitle/metaDescription/ogImage/canonicalUrl) actually publish nahi hote, quality gates (K) me se zyada tar missing.

findings.title: Live API key committed in PUBLIC repository (.vscode/settings.json)
findings.affected: .vscode/settings.json:2 (tracked & pushed to public GitHub repo anwariqbaldawar/xCipher, commit baaf6ac, pushed 2026-10-09)
findings.evidence: opencode.apiKey = sk-7...YbQW (REDACTED) pointing to https://api.agentrouter.com/v1; `git ls-files` me file tracked; `gh repo view` → isPrivate: false
findings.impact: Koi bhi insaan repo clone karke key utha sakta hai — quota abuse, financial loss, account takeover tak. Repo public hai, to exposure active hai.
findings.rootCause: .vscode/ project settings ko commit kar diya gaya; .gitignore me .vscode/ nahi (ya settings.json alag se force-add hua).
findings.fix: 1) Key abhi REVOKE/ROTATE karein (agentrouter dashboard). 2) File git se hatayein: `git rm --cached .vscode/settings.json` + commit. 3) Git history purge: git filter-repo ya BFG (repo public hai to history rewrite zaroori). 4) `.vscode/` ko .gitignore me daalein. 5) GitHub push protection/secret scanning enable karein.
findings.verification: Repo ke raw file URL par 404 + GitHub code search (key prefix) zero results + purana key reject ho.
findings.implementation: Repo-side applied: key removed from tracked .vscode/settings.json (commit 9ff83e4) + ignore guard. OWNER PENDING: revoke the key and purge git history.

findings.title: Main sitemap pages.xml mein zero article/category/tag/author URLs (sirf 19 static paths)
findings.evidence: Do live fetches (2026-10-13): sirf 19 static <url> entries (/, /latest, /series, /page/*), saare lastmod = 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z (hardcoded fallback at route.ts:66) — matlab articles query empty/fail. Sitemap index lastmod (2026-10-12T23:38:04) alag se DB se aaya, yaani DB reachable hai.
findings.impact: Discovery ka main channel toota hua hai: Google/Bing ko articles/categories/tags/authors sitemap se nahi milte. Naye site (5 articles, kam backlinks) ke liye indexing speed aur coverage directly suffer karti hai. News sitemap sirf 48h window rakhta hai.
findings.rootCause: Saari 4 queries ek hi Promise.all (route.ts:57) mein hain — ek bhi query throw kare to catch (line 102) chup-chaap saara dynamic content khaali rakh deta hai. [Likely specific trigger] authors query legacy table "_ArticleToAuthor" (line 84) use karti hai jo Drizzle schema (lib/db/schema.ts) mein exist nahi karti — Prisma→Drizzle migration ke baad table drop hua to poora batch fail.
findings.fix: Har query ko alag try/catch mein daalein (partial success), authors query ko Article.authorId se likhein, aur catch mein console.warn ko alerting se jodein. Complete patch: fixes/sitemap-pages.patch
findings.verification: Deploy ke baad: curl sitemap/pages.xml → articles/categories/tags/authors URLs + aaj ka lastmod; phir GSC Sitemaps report submit.
findings.implementation: Applied: per-query isolation + Article.authorId authors query (commit e385452). Verify after deploy: /sitemap/pages.xml lists articles with today's lastmod.

findings.title: /api/og (sab ka og:image) production mein HTTP 500 return karta hai
findings.affected: https://xsypher.com/api/og?title=... (app/api/og/route.tsx) — har article page isko og:image mein use karta hai (app/(public)/article/[slug]/page.tsx:82-96)
findings.evidence: 2 live fetches: `GET /api/og?title=Test` → HTTP 500, `GET /api/og` → HTTP 500 (route ka catch handler 'Failed to generate image' return karta hai, route.tsx:126-130).
findings.impact: Facebook/LinkedIn/WhatsApp/X shares par image nahi aayegi → CTR kam. Social/OG signals weak. Editor ka 'Social Share Image (OG)' upload bhi iske peeche hide hai (wo kabhi use hi nahi hota — TSEO-003).
findings.rootCause: [Hypothesis — server log chahiye] Satori/ImageResponse render fail: (a) ARM64/alpine image mein resvg native binary missing, (b) default font load failure, ya (c) Redis ready hone par corrupt cache entry. Route console.error(e) karta hai — log line '[og]' ya 'Failed to generate image' grep karein.
findings.fix: 1) Server log se exact error nikalein. 2) Fallback: agar render fail ho to featured image (article.ogImage/img) serve karein 200 ke saath. 3) Root cause theek karein (Dockerfile mein native deps verify).
findings.verification: curl -I 'https://xsypher.com/api/og?title=test' → 200 + Content-Type: image/png; phir Facebook Sharing Debugger mein scrape.
findings.implementation: Applied: render is materialised in try/catch and falls back to public/og-fallback.png with a 5-minute TTL (commit 7eca1f1). STILL WANTED: the '[og] Render failed' log line to fix the root cause.

findings.title: SEO panel ke primary fields (metaTitle/metaDescription) publish hote hi nahi — SERP preview jhoot bolta hai
findings.affected: components/editorial/ArticleEditor.tsx:1725-1775 (primary fields + char counters + Google SERP Preview) vs app/(public)/article/[slug]/page.tsx:89-90 (generateMetadata)
findings.evidence: Editor: 'Meta Title' (metaTitle) with 60-char counter + SeoPreview jo metaTitle se banta hai; save: app/actions/article.ts:223 metaTitle DB mein jaata hai. Lekin live metadata: `title: article.seoTitle || article.title`, `description: article.seoDesc || article.deck` — metaTitle/metaDescription kabhi read hi nahi hote (grep: article page par metaTitle = 0 matches). Editor mein seoTitle/seoDesc ko 'Legacy' label kiya gaya hai — fallback chains ulti hain.
findings.impact: Editor jo meta title/description likhta aur preview karta hai wo SERP mein kabhi nahi aata (jab tak legacy field alag se na bhari ho). Poora SEO workflow silently ineffective — nishani: editors ko lagta hai optimize ho raha hai, hota nahi.
findings.rootCause: Do generations ke fields (naya metaTitle vs purana seoTitle) migration ke beech sync nahi hue; render path ne purana naam chhoda nahi.
findings.fix: generateMetadata ko badlein: `title: article.metaTitle || article.seoTitle || article.title` (aur description bhi isi order), ya editor ko ek hi field par converge karein. fixes/generateMetadata-meta-fields.patch dekhein.
findings.verification: Ek article mein metaTitle badlein → view-source mein <title> wahi dikhe; SeoPreview aur live <title> match karein.
findings.implementation: Applied: title/description now resolve metaTitle || seoTitle || title etc. (commit 3b3faf2). Verify: type a meta title in the editor, check view-source.

findings.title: ads.txt missing (404) — AdSense active site par
findings.evidence: Live fetch → 404 (custom not-found page). Repo: public/ mein koi ads.txt nahi, koi route bhi nahi. AdSense code present (components/common/AdUnit.tsx, NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_CLIENT_ID).
findings.impact: AdSense policy: authorized seller mismatch = invalid inventory warnings, ads.txt missing warning, revenue pause tak ho sakta hai. DSP resellers ke pas ye file verify karni hoti hai.
findings.rootCause: ads.txt file kabhi bani hi nahi (ad serving baad mein add hui, ads.txt ka step miss).
findings.fix: public/ads.txt banayein: `google.com, pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` (apna publisher ID ke saath). Exact file: fixes/ads.txt (pub-XXXX aap badlein).
findings.verification: https://xsypher.com/ads.txt → 200; AdSense Sites → ads.txt status green.
findings.implementation: Applied: public/ads.txt served (commit e3da25a). OWNER: replace pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX with the real publisher ID.

findings.title: Listing pagination crawlable nahi — 'Load More' button sirf client-side (sitemap ke saath compound risk)
findings.evidence: PaginatedFeed ek 'use client' button hai jo server action getMoreArticles(offset) call karta hai — koi <a href='?page=2'> link nahi. Grep: /latest par koi page param link nahi. Category page: `initialHasMore={articles.length === LISTING_ARTICLE_LIMIT}`.
findings.impact: Bots ko sirf pehle ~20 articles dikhte hain; baaki archive links ke bina unreachable. CRW-001 (sitemap khaali) ke saath ye compound hai — purani content ki discovery fully internal links par depend karti hai.
findings.rootCause: Infinite-scroll/Load-More UX ko crawlable pagination link ke saath complement nahi kiya gaya.
findings.fix: Load More ke neeche ek asli anchor: `Page 2` (ya numbered links), aur page param server par support karein (tag page pattern already exist karta hai).
findings.verification: View-source mein page-2 links; GSC URL Inspection se page 2 crawlable.
findings.implementation: Deferred by design: crawlable pagination links change how /latest and /category render and need a staging test cycle with real DB data; implementation sketch is in the report (Section 5.1, CRW-002).

findings.title: /invite/* aur /unsubscribe/* token URLs robots.txt mein block nahi aur noindex bhi nahi
findings.evidence: robots.txt: Disallow sirf /admin/, /api/, /search, /preview, /_next/, /*?_rsc=*. Invite/unsubscribe pages par robots meta grep = 0 matches (preview page par hai — app/preview/[id]/page.tsx:39).
findings.impact: Agar koi in token URLs ko link/share kare to Google index kar sakta hai — unsubscribe/invite tokens public logs, referrer headers aur SERP mein leak. Security + UX dono ka risk.
findings.rootCause: Naye app routes ka robots.txt entry aur noindex metadata dono miss.
findings.fix: robots.ts mein disallow add karein aur pages par `robots: { index: false }` — fixes/robots.ts.patch.
findings.verification: GSC URL Inspection: 'Blocked by robots.txt' ya meta noindex.
findings.implementation: Applied: /invite and /unsubscribe disallowed in app/robots.ts (commit 675ad42).

findings.title: Koi analytics installed hi nahi (GA4/Plausible/Umami zero) — SEO/perf decisions blind
findings.affected: app/(public)/layout.tsx (AdSenseScript, CookieConsent, lekin koi analytics script nahi); grep gtag/plausible/umami = 0 code matches
findings.evidence: Layout mein sirf AdSenseScript mount hota hai. Transparency page kehti hai 'No third-party analytics scripts' (sahi), jabke privacy/cookie policy pages 'Google Analytics or Plausible' ka zikr karte hain — policy vs reality mismatch.
findings.impact: Traffic, conversions, top queries, indexation impact — kuch measure nahi kar sakte. GSC ke bina (access nahi diya) aur analytics ke bina audit ke KPIs follow-up possible nahi. Policy text bhi inaccurate hai.
findings.rootCause: Analytics integrate hi nahi hua (privacy-first choice bhi ho sakti hai — confirm karein), lekin policies generic text rakhe hue hain.
findings.fix: Plausible/Umami (privacy-friendly, consent-light) ya GA4 + Consent Mode add karein; policy pages ko actual stack se sync karein.
findings.verification: Page load par network mein analytics request + dashboard mein live event.
findings.implementation: Open — owner decision: analytics account (Plausible/GA4); policy pages must be synced with the real stack.

findings.title: Public pages ki CSP mein script-src 'unsafe-inline' (bina nonce) + connect-src bahut broad
findings.affected: middleware.ts:38-57 (buildCsp — isStaticPublic branch 'unsafe-inline' use karta hai), connect-src 'self' https:
findings.evidence: middleware.ts:40-42: `isStaticPublic ? script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' ... : script-src 'self' 'nonce-...'`. Har public ISR page par inline script injection freely run ho sakti hai agar HTML mein kahin bhi injection ho. connect-src https: = kisi bhi HTTPS endpoint ko beja ja sakta hai (exfiltration).
findings.impact: XSS ke against defence-in-depth kamzor — especially jabki article body R2 se aata hai (stored HTML). Sanitizer (DOMPurify) primary defence hai, CSP sirf backup, aur backup public pages par nahi.
findings.rootCause: Comment (middleware.ts:27-36): static/ISR pages ko SSG hydration scripts ke liye unsafe-inline chahiye — Next.js ke inline bootstrap ko nonce dena possible hai lekin implementation complex tha.
findings.fix: Next.js15+ mein hydration scripts nonce pass karke unsafe-inline hata sakte hain (layout already nonce forward karta hai); kam az kam connect-src ko explicit allowlist (`'self' https://*.sentry.io https://rsms.me/...`) karein. Draft: fixes/csp-draft.txt
findings.verification: Browser DevTools → Console mein CSP violation reports; securityheaders.com score A+.
findings.implementation: Applied: explicit connect-src allowlist per Google's CSP guidance (commit 1b7d8fa). Verify the browser console after deploy for CSP violations.

findings.title: DMARC policy sirf p=none, SPF ~all — domain spoofing protection weak
findings.affected: DNS: _dmarc.xsypher.com, xsypher.com TXT (verified via dns.google DoH, 2026-10-13)
findings.evidence: DMARC: `v=DMARC1; p=none;` (koi rua/rua aggregate report address nahi). SPF: `v=spf1 include:_spf.mx.cloudflare.net include:resend.com ~all`. DKIM: resend._domainkey TXT present ✓.
findings.impact: Koi bhi aapke domain se phishing email bhej sakta hai (p=none receiver ko sirf report karta hai, block nahi). Journalistic brand ke liye spoofed email = trust/reputation risk.
findings.rootCause: Setup mein monitor-mode chhoda gaya, strict par upgrade nahi hua.
findings.fix: 1) `v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; pct=25; rua=mailto:dmarc@xsypher.com; adkim=r; aspf=r` pehle, phir 2 hafte reports ke baad `p=reject`. 2) SPF `~all` → `-all`.
findings.verification: DMARC report mein legitimate senders clean; mail-tester.com se test mail 9/10+.
findings.implementation: Open — owner action: DNS records (fixes/dmarc-recommendation.txt).

findings.title: StoryRow (feed thumbnail) fill images mein sizes attribute nahi — default 100vw par download
findings.evidence: Automated scan of all .tsx: `fill` WITHOUT `sizes=` → StoryRow.tsx:58, category/[slug]:127 (admin/preview alag). StoryCard.tsx:62 mein sizes ✓ (feed cards theek).
findings.impact: StoryRow har listing page ka main row component hai (/latest, /category, homepage 'More' sections). 100vw default = ~400px slot ke liye 800-1600px+ image → data waste, mobile listing pages ki LCP/INP impact, unnecessary _next/image CPU.
findings.rootCause: fill use karte waqt sizes prop add karna bhool gaye (Next.js default 100vw apply hota hai).
findings.fix: `sizes="(max-width: 768px) 120px, 160px"` (row thumbnail actual display width ke mutabiq) — fixes/storyrow-sizes.patch
findings.verification: DevTools Network: listing images ab slot-width candidates serve karein; PSI mobile FCP improve (estimate: listing pages par 100-400KB per page bach sakte hain).
findings.implementation: Applied: sizes=118px on StoryRow, responsive sizes on the category feature (commit 41719cd).

findings.title: ArticleBody statically bundles EditorialBlockViewer (react-tweet, TikTok embed, block CSS)
findings.affected: components/article/ArticleBody.tsx:12 (static import) vs line 9-11 (charts/mermaid dynamic hain)
findings.evidence: ArticleBody.tsx: `import EditorialBlockViewer from './EditorialBlockViewer'` (static) — jabke DynamicChart/FrontendMermaidViewer/InteractiveChartViewer next/dynamic se hain. EditorialBlockViewer.tsx:8 `import { Tweet } from 'react-tweet'` (static) + TikTokEmbed + editorial-blocks.css. highlight.js bhi dynamic ✓.
findings.impact: Har article page ka initial JS bundle react-tweet + embed machinery carry karta hai chahe article mein tweet ho ya na ho — TBT/hydration cost, mobile pe scroll jank.
findings.rootCause: Dynamic-import discipline sab blocks par uniformly apply nahi hui (AGENTS.md rule sirf heavy libs par lagta hai).
findings.fix: `const EditorialBlockViewer = dynamic(() => import('./EditorialBlockViewer'), { ssr: false })` — embeds waale blocks ke render ke waqt hi load hoga (ArticleBody pehle se unclean DOM parse karta hai, mismatch risk low).
findings.verification: next build output: article route ka first-load JS kam hua; Lighthouse TBT improvement (estimate 50-150ms).
findings.implementation: Applied (narrower than proposed): react-tweet is client-only dynamic; EditorialBlockViewer stays server-rendered on purpose so editorial blocks remain in the SSR HTML for crawlers (commit 41719cd).

findings.title: Editor ke 'Social Share Image (OG)' aur 'Canonical URL' fields bhi no-op hain
findings.evidence: Editor OG upload: text 'If left blank, the featured image is used as the OpenGraph image' — lekin generateMetadata hamesha `/api/og` URL banata hai (line 86), ogImage field kabhi read nahi (grep = 0). canonicalUrl save hota hai (actions/article.ts:227) lekin canonical hamesha `/article/${article.slug}` (line 92).
findings.impact: Editors jo custom OG image/canonical set karein wo apply hi nahi hota — broken promises + duplicate-content control ka effective tareeqa kaam nahi karta. OG image ka to TSEO-001 mein 500 bhi hai.
findings.rootCause: CMS fields render pipeline se wire nahi hue (migration leftover, same as TSEO-002).
findings.fix: `image: article.ogImage || ogUrl` aur `canonical: article.canonicalUrl || /article/${slug}` (sanitized URL validation ke saath).
findings.verification: Article mein custom OG dalein → view-source og:image wahi; canonical override test GSC URL Inspection.
findings.implementation: Applied: ogImage and canonicalUrl are consumed with safe fallbacks (commit 3b3faf2).

findings.title: Pre-publish quality gates adhoore: sirf title/deck/50-words check; alt/meta/broken-links/readability checks missing
findings.evidence: Pre-flight: title required, deck ≥10 chars, ≥50 words. Missing: missing-featured-image-alt gate (alt optional field), missing-meta warning, broken-link check, duplicate-title check, readability score, plagiarism, heading-hierarchy validator, a11y check. Grep readability/broken-link/plagiarism = 0 app code mein.
findings.impact: Quality issues publish ke baad discover hote hain (ya kabhi nahi). Small team ke liye yehi gates editorial quality ka insurance hote hain.
findings.rootCause: MVP scope — gates sirf basic content shape tak seemit.
findings.fix: Priority order: (1) featured image + alt required on PUBLISHED, (2) SEO description required, (3) outbound link checker (async), (4) duplicate title check against DB. Roadmap section mein phased.
findings.verification: Khaali alt wala article publish karne se roka jaye (gate error).
findings.implementation: Applied (P1 gate): featured image alt required on submit/publish (commit 9456e7f). Remaining gates (broken links, duplicate titles, readability) stay in the 30/60-day plan.

findings.title: Brand/entity presence bahar se zero — sirf founder ka GitHub profile mila
findings.evidence: Web searches: 'xSypher' quoted search = 0 results; 'xSypher Anwar Iqbal Dawar publication' → sirf github.com/anwariqbaldawar/AnwarIqbaldawar. Wikipedia/Wikidata/directories/reviews/mentions: koi nahi.
findings.impact: AI answers (ChatGPT/Perplexity/AI Overviews) authority entities ko cite karte hain — off-site corroboration zero hone se citation probability low, Knowledge Graph readiness zero.
findings.rootCause: Nayi site (2025 founded) — abhi tak digital PR/entity building shuru nahi.
findings.fix: Entity plan (report Section 6): Wikidata item banao, Google Knowledge Panel signal (sameAs badhao Organization schema mein), tech directories (Product Hunt, HackerNews launch, IndieHackers), guest posts/broken-link PR, GitHub org page, LinkedIn company page. 90-din roadmap mein phased.
findings.verification: Brand search par knowledge panel/mentions; AI citation test protocol (GEO-004) repeat.

findings.title: AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider) implicitly allowed — explicit policy decision chahiye
findings.evidence: Live robots.txt mein koi AI-specific group nahi → sab par wildcard allow. 2026 official UA list (web search se verify): GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot/Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Bytespider, meta-externalagent/fetcher.
findings.impact: Retrieval/search bots ke liye allow = sahi (GEO visibility). Training bots allow = aapka content model training mein ja sakta hai (aapki marzi). Explicit rules hone se audit trail aur clarity milti hai. NOTE: Cloudflare WAF mein bhi bot rules check karne hain (screenshots pending).
findings.rootCause: Policy explicitly set nahi hui thi.
findings.fix: Business decision aapka: Option A (visibility-first, sab allow + explicit allow rules) ya Option B (training block + search allow). Dono ready: fixes/robots-visibility-first.txt aur fixes/robots-training-block.txt
findings.verification: robots.txt fetch + server logs mein bot UA counts (aapke paas logs access hai — grep pattern report appendix mein).
findings.implementation: Applied: explicit AI crawler groups, visibility-first Option A (commit 675ad42). Switch to training-block via fixes/robots-training-block.txt if desired.

findings.title: ESLint failing (351 errors / 100 warnings) aur CI mein lint gate hi nahi
findings.evidence: `npm run lint` exit 1: 451 problems — 285 no-explicit-any, 91 no-unused-vars, 43 unescaped-entities, 6 no-img-element. CI (deploy.yml): sirf tsc + test + prod audit — lint step hi nahi, `next build` gate bhi nahi.
findings.impact: Lint debt silently badhta hai; build-breaking changes sirf production deploy par pakde jate hain (deploy mein docker build hi build gate hai — fail hone par pura deploy rukta hai, rollback nahi).
findings.rootCause: Quality gate incomplete — README claims 'lint gates' lekin workflow mein nahi.
findings.fix: CI mein `npm run lint --max-warnings=0` (pehle debt down karein: --fix + any-types codemod) + `next build` dry-run step. fixes/ci-gate.yml snippet.
findings.verification: CI green lint ke saath; local `npm run lint` exit 0.
findings.implementation: Applied: build gate + non-blocking lint in CI (commit a861b27). Wanted later: clear the lint debt, then make it blocking.

findings.title: Deploy pipeline mein post-deploy health gate, rollback, aur reproducible installs nahi
findings.evidence: Script: git reset --hard → `npm install --production=false` (host par, lockfile drift possible) → docker compose build --no-cache → up -d → image prune. Koi health-check wait, koi rollback, koi version pin nahi. README ke 'automated gates' mein sirf verify job hai.
findings.impact: Kharab deploy (jaise abhi wala og-image bug) manually spot hona padta hai; recovery = manual. --no-cache har baar = slow builds, layer cache fayda nahi.
findings.rootCause: Pipeline basic SSH automation par ruki hui hai.
findings.fix: 1) `npm ci` on host, 2) deploy ke baad health poll (`/api/health` 200, 30s tak) — fail par `docker compose rollback to previous image tag`, 3) `--no-cache` hatao (Dockerfile change par hi cache bust). fixes/deploy-health-gate.sh snippet.
findings.verification: Staging par jaan-bujh kar bad build → pipeline auto-rollback dikhaye.
findings.implementation: Applied: npm ci, layer-cached builds, post-deploy health gate with log dump (commit a861b27). Rollback still manual (needs versioned image tags).

findings.title: AdSense ke liye single global slot + TCF-certified CMP ka gap (EEA/UK traffic par policy risk)
findings.evidence: AdUnit: `slotId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_SLOT_ID` — saare placements (top/sidebar/mid-feed/category) ek hi slot. CookieConsent: accepted/declined, koi TCF v2 consent string nahi, koi per-category controls nahi.

findings.rootCause: MVP ad setup + homegrown consent.
findings.fix: Per-placement slot IDs (AdSense dashboard mein units banao); EEA traffic par Google Certified CMP (Consent Manager, Sourcepoint, ya Google's own Funding Choices) — PK/US traffic ke liye custom banner chal sakta hai lekin geo-rule saaf rakho.
findings.verification: AdSense Policy Center clean; EEA mein consent string (TCF) network mein present.
findings.implementation: Open — owner action: per-placement AdSense units and a TCF-certified CMP for EEA/UK traffic.

findings.title: IndexNow key fallback 'xsypher-key' (env unset hone par weak key)
findings.evidence: `key=${process.env.INDEXNOW_KEY || 'xsypher-key'}` — agar production .env mein INDEXNOW_KEY nahi to sab pings weak default key se ja rahe hain (URL-submission method ke liye key file verify nahi hoti, lekin key unique honi chahiye).
findings.impact: Koi aur aapki domain key guess karke aapke naam se spam URL submit kar sakta hai (limited blast radius).
findings.rootCause: Dev fallback value production tak.
findings.fix: `openssl rand -hex 16` se key banao, .env.production mein INDEXNOW_KEY set karo, fallback hatao (env missing par warn log).
findings.verification: Log mein ping key aapki random key ho.
findings.implementation: Applied: guessable IndexNow fallback removed; missing env skips with a warning (commit 675ad42). Set INDEXNOW_KEY on the host (fixes/indexnow-key.sh).

findings.title: Caddy health check /api/health ka 503 ('degraded') poore site ko 502 kar sakta hai (Redis outage = full site outage)
findings.evidence: health route: `status: ok ? 200 : 503` (redis.down -> degraded -> 503). Caddy reverse_proxy health_uri non-2xx = upstream unhealthy -> Caddy koi available upstream nahi dhundhta to 502 serve karta hai. Yani ioredis outage (ya 2s timeout flap) par visitors ko 502, chahe Next.js bilkul theek ho.
findings.impact: Single point of failure ka blast radius badh gaya: cache/queue dependency ki kami full outage bana deti hai. Redis mostly resilient hai (retry strategy) lekin health check ka fail-mode dangerous hai.
findings.rootCause: Health endpoint 'dependency health' (503) aur 'process liveness' (200) ko same route par mix karta hai; proxy layer liveness samajh raha hai.
findings.fix: Do options: (a) /api/health hamesha 200 rakho jab tak Next.js respond kar raha ho (body mein checks flags), degrade alert Sentry/monitor ko bhejo; ya (b) Caddy health mein sirf liveness route (naya /api/healthz -> 200) do. fixes/caddy-headers.conf NOTE dekhein.
findings.verification: Redis band karo -> site ab bhi 200 serve kare; alert aaye. Phir Redis on -> checks green.
findings.implementation: Applied: /api/healthz liveness + Caddyfile.example updated (commit a861b27). /api/health stays the dependency-health endpoint for monitors.
